evals.expected_output: Shows current sprint/iteration status including work items, their states, and progress metrics
expectations: Defaults to status mode when no arguments provided
Reads session-state.json for tracked work item states
Queries tracker for current iteration work items

evals.expected_output: Selects the highest-priority ready work item and delegates to /implement
expectations: Queries tracker for work items in the current iteration
Filters to items in Todo/Ready state with no unresolved blockers
Ranks by priority and selects the top item
Delegates to /implement with the selected work item ID

evals.expected_output: Runs completion gate checks and transitions the work item to Done if all gates pass
expectations: Validates all documentation deliverables are produced per proportionality tier
Checks PR is merged and tests pass
Transitions work item to Done state via tracker operations
Updates session-state.json to reflect completed state

evals.expected_output: Generates a structured standup report summarizing yesterday's work, today's plan, and blockers
expectations: Reviews git log and session state for recent activity
Identifies completed, in-progress, and blocked items
Formats output as yesterday/today/blockers standup structure
